product.title: Machu Picchu Private Full-Day Tour from Cusco

description.text: In Cusco, this private full-day Machu Picchu outing keeps the train, buffet lunch, and citadel walk on one party, with hotel pickup and private station transfers included. The published guided circuit covers the Temple of the Sun and the Sacred Plaza inside Machu Picchu after the Sacred Valley rail segment. Vistadome and Huayna Picchu are listed as extras rather than the base From price. The calendar day is about 15 hours. The format suits visitors who want a private citadel day without sharing the guide with another group. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cusco, and the itinerary stays on the Sacred Valley rail corridor, Aguas Calientes, and Machu Picchu that define this private outing rather than a two-day valley overnight.
